description: In an i18next project, turn a key the project already has into plural forms in the base locale. Use this for a count_without_plural finding, where a string shows {{count}} but has no plural forms; add_key refuses a key that already exists. WRITES to your project, and there is no preview: the call writes. It replaces the key's current base text with the forms you send, so write every form the base language uses (the finding names them) and keep the placeholders. It writes the BASE file only, and the user reviews the forms in the diff. Send the key exactly as the finding reports it. If owedByLocale on the result lists any locale, those locales now owe forms of their own and prepare_translation_plan offers them; do not report the work as done until they are filled. A key that already has plural forms is refused, and so is a project in any other format.

forms.description: The base text for each plural category, as the CLDR names them. Send exactly the categories the base language uses; the finding names them.

few.description: The few form, only if the base language uses it.

many.description: The many form, only if the base language uses it.

one.description: The one form, only if the base language uses it.

other.description: The other form. Always required: every language uses it.

two.description: The two form, only if the base language uses it.

zero.description: The zero form, only if the base language uses it.

key.description: The merged key exactly as inspect_project or validate_translations report it.

name: pluralize_key
title: Give an existing key its plural forms
